user_confirmed.statement: The baseline is official pretrained YOLO weights fine-tuned on a subset of the WHU Building Dataset, specifically the 'Satellite dataset II (East Asia)' cropped image data and raster labels.

pretrained_weights_origin.evidence: weights/yolov8m-seg.pt loads as SegmentationModel with nc=80 and the 80 COCO class names, date 2023-01-04.

dataset_identity.value: WHU Building Dataset, 'Satellite dataset II (East Asia)', cropped image data and raster labels; split into 4038 tiles of 512x512
dataset_identity.evidence: scripts/mask_to_yolo.py lines 11-12 name the source and output roots; the derived YOLO dataset contains 4038 image/label pairs.

known_issues.issue: The baseline depends on an EDITABLE install of ultralytics that resolves OUTSIDE this project.
known_issues.detail: The editable finder maps the 'ultralytics' package to a mutable external source directory. The baseline is therefore not portable and not reproducible from this repository alone.
known_issues.constraint: The proposed method MUST NOT depend on this mutable external fork.

known_issues.detail: save_json was false, so no COCO/test metrics were produced. Only 903 visualization images exist.
known_issues.impact: Any published number must come from a proper held-out test protocol that has not yet been run.

known_issues.issue: The logged sem_loss column is identically 0 for all 100 epochs.
known_issues.detail: The external fork defines a fifth loss term (semantic BCE+Dice). It only activates when the model's proto output is a tuple carrying a semantic prediction, which is not the case for this configuration.
known_issues.impact: The run used only the 4 standard YOLO losses (box, seg, cls, dfl). Do not claim semantic supervision.

known_issues.issue: Instance definition is connected-component based and touching buildings are irreversibly merged.
known_issues.detail: Original raster labels are pure binary (values {0,255}). cv2.findContours with RETR_EXTERNAL was used, so any mutually touching buildings became a single instance. Measured: 2.601% of instance pairs have contour distance <= 1.5 px; the single largest instance covers 49.99% of its 512x512 tile.
known_issues.impact: overlap / contain / inside relations are structurally empty (0 of 25454 sampled pairs); strict-touch adjacency is unreliable.

known_issues.issue: patience (100) equals epochs (100), disabling early stopping.
known_issues.impact: Mask mAP50 peaked at 0.84373 around epoch 44 and drifted down to 0.80693 by epoch 100, so the final checkpoint is not the best-performing one by that metric.

known_issues.issue: val is a random 20% subset of the original train pool rather than a geographically disjoint split.
known_issues.impact: Risk of scene-level leakage between train and val. Acceptable for a baseline, but a stronger split must be used for reasoning-query evaluation.

known_issues.issue: A COCO detection checkpoint (yolo26n.pt, nc=80) sits at the legacy project root.
known_issues.detail: It is a DetectionModel trained for 245 epochs on COCO and is unrelated to building segmentation; it was not used by the recorded run.
known_issues.impact: Footgun only; it is not part of this baseline.

known_issues.issue: opencv.imread fails on the legacy absolute dataset path (non-ASCII characters), returning None.
known_issues.detail: The existing conversion script already contains a Pillow fallback that handles this.
known_issues.impact: Any future script touching the raw raster dataset must use the Pillow path or a re-encoded source.

known_issues.issue: The frozen run_record/args.yaml contains one absolute path (save_dir on line 110).
known_issues.detail: It was written by Ultralytics during the original run and is retained so that the record stays byte-identical to the legacy source. No program in this repository reads args.yaml.
known_issues.impact: Cosmetic only. Any absolute-path audit of this repository will flag exactly this one line; it is an allowed exception, documented in baseline/yolo_whu/README.md section 7.
